name: Doggy Tricks 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Doggy Tricks is a mischievous casual game where you step into the paws of a naughty dog adopted from a shelter. Each level offers a new chaotic adventure as you explore the house, set clever traps, and unleash pranks to keep your unsuspecting owner on his toes.
